children: The dollar turns modestly lower as U.S. stock futures fall, pointing to a pullback in tech stocks following Monday's rally sparked by Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia chief executive. Nvidia's announcement Monday had boosted capital inflows into U.S. tech stocks and bolstered expectations for further interest-rate increases by the Federal Reserve, lifting the dollar. The DXY dollar index falls 0.1% to 104.245, having reached a 20-month high of 104.530 Monday. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
